mapper.select: SELECT mn.menu_id, mn.tenant_id, mn.module_id, m.module_nm, mn.parent_menu_id, NULL AS parent_menu_nm, mn.menu_code, mn.menu_nm, mn.menu_url, mn.icon_nm, mn.sort_order, mn.use_at, mn.created_at, mn.updated_at, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_menu c WHERE c.parent_menu_id = mn.menu_id AND c.use_at = 'Y')) AS has_children FROM tb_menu mn JOIN tb_module m ON m.module_id = mn.module_id WHERE mn.tenant_id = #{value} AND mn.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY mn.module_id ASC, mn.sort_order ASC, mn.menu_id ASC

SELECT mn.menu_id, mn.tenant_id, mn.module_id, m.module_nm, mn.parent_menu_id, pmn.menu_nm AS parent_menu_nm, mn.menu_code, mn.menu_nm, mn.menu_url, mn.icon_nm, mn.sort_order, mn.use_at, mn.created_at, mn.updated_at, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_menu c WHERE c.parent_menu_id = mn.menu_id)) AS has_children FROM tb_menu mn JOIN tb_module m ON m.module_id = mn.module_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu pmn ON pmn.menu_id = mn.parent_menu_id WHERE mn.menu_id = #{menuId} AND mn.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT menu_id FROM tb_menu WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND menu_code = #{menuCode}

INSERT INTO tb_menu (tenant_id, module_id, parent_menu_id, menu_code, menu_nm, menu_url, icon_nm, sort_order, use_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{moduleId}, #{parentMenuId}, #{menuCode}, #{menuNm}, #{menuUrl}, #{iconNm}, #{sortOrder}, #{useAt}) RETURNING menu_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu SET parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId}, menu_nm = #{menuNm}, menu_url = #{menuUrl}, icon_nm = #{iconNm}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_menu WHERE parent_menu_id = #{menuId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
